description: Telemetry detail emitted by the WYSIWYG watchdog during runtime recovery.

members.name: BackoffMs
members.description: Backoff delay used for this attempt.

members.name: ErrorMessage
members.description: Error message captured from the failed runtime operation, if available.

members.name: Event
members.description: Recovery event name, such as runtimeRecovered or runtimeRecoveryFailed.

members.name: Source
members.description: Runtime area that raised the failure, such as command, remoteOperation, render, or serialization.

members.name: Timestamp
members.description: ISO timestamp reported by the runtime watchdog.

members.name: UsedSnapshotFallback
members.description: Whether recovery used the last stable snapshot instead of a live snapshot.
